summary: Both editions were independently checked against every clause of the supplied Greek working source. Neither has a concrete fidelity defect warranting revision. Both preserve the categorical assertions about sorrow, the prayer/confession negations, speaker changes, altar imagery, difficult concluding prayer comparison, and conditions for living to God. The cheerful-Spirit reading is disclosed with an alternative; the repeated English “Spirit” is identified in metadata as a clarifying supply. Reported textual alternatives remain distinct from the selected reading rather than being harmonized into it. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied source and disclosure of the stated alternatives; it does not authenticate the cited external witnesses, images, or collation history, or establish a unique interpretation.
